tools.name: get_dashboard_summary
tools.description: High-level health of the workspace: connected integrations by status and the most recent account activity. Use this first to answer 'how is my business set up / what's connected'.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: List the workspace's connected channels and data sources (Amazon, Flipkart, Snapdeal, Shopify, Meta, Google, etc.) with their connection status, health score, and last sync time.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the workspace's MASTER product catalog by free text (matches product title, brand, or internal SKU). Returns up to 25 matches with MRP, mapped-channel count, and status. Narrow the query if results are truncated.

tools.name: get_brand_score
tools.description: The latest brand-health score for the workspace — a weighted average across tracked marketplace listings (listing quality, reviews, availability, compliance). Returns the most recent day's score and the listing count it covers.

tools.name: get_channel_orders_overview
tools.description: Order volume across the workspace's connected non-Amazon marketplaces (Snapdeal, Flipkart, Myntra, JioMart, Meesho). Returns the order count synced per channel — use it to see which marketplaces have data and their relative scale.

tools.name: get_shelf_availability
tools.description: Quick-commerce on-shelf availability (OSA%) over the last 7 days, per channel — the share of observed shelves where the product was in stock. Lower is worse. Requires a Q-Radar subscription.

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: List every connected store/marketplace account (Amazon, Shopify, Flipkart, Snapdeal, Meesho, Myntra, JioMart, Ajio, offline) with its display name, country/currency, and order count in the last 30 days.

tools.name: get_pnl_summary
tools.description: Amazon settlement-based money summary over a window: revenue, marketplace fees, refunds, TCS/TDS, net amount Amazon settled, FBA reimbursements, net to seller, plus order/return/reimbursement counts. Amounts are in major currency units.

tools.name: get_orders_summary
tools.description: Order volume per channel over a window, across all connected marketplaces. Use it to see where orders are coming from and the relative scale per channel.

tools.name: get_payments_summary
tools.description: Settlement/payment activity: the net amount Amazon settled over the window (major units) plus the count of settlement/payment records synced per channel.

tools.name: get_returns_summary
tools.description: Amazon returns over a window: total count, total units, and the top return reasons and dispositions.

tools.name: get_reimbursements_summary
tools.description: Amazon FBA reimbursements over a window: total amount (major units), count, units, and the top reimbursement reasons.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: Warehouse stock levels by SKU (available, reserved, incoming, blocked) joined to the master product (name, cost, MRP). Optional free-text search by SKU; returns up to 25 rows.

tools.name: get_stock_status
tools.description: Out-of-stock status across tracked marketplace listings: total listings, OOS count, OOS breakdown by channel, and a sample of the currently out-of-stock listings.

tools.name: list_sellers
tools.description: Sellers observed on tracked listings (the competitive seller universe) with their classification and rating. Optional channel filter.

tools.name: list_competitors
tools.description: Operator-curated competitors being tracked, with priority and status.

tools.name: get_compliance_violations
tools.description: Minimum-advertised-price / MRP compliance violations: open + escalated counts, breakdown by channel, and the most recent open violations.

tools.name: get_margin_config
tools.description: Per-product margin configuration used for P&L: COGS and platform-fee percentage, optionally per channel. Returns up to 25 rows.

tools.name: get_marketplace_alerts
tools.description: Marketplace alert events (price drops, OOS, MAP breaches, etc.) fired in a window: counts by type and severity, plus the most recent events.

tools.name: get_psl_movers
tools.description: Top potential-sales-loss (PSL) movers from quick-commerce shelf intelligence over a window — the products losing the most estimated sales to out-of-stock, by channel. Requires a Q-Radar subscription.

tools.name: get_tax_summary
tools.description: GST snapshot for a period: taxable value, CGST/SGST/IGST/cess, total tax and invoice count (B2B + B2C split), plus TCS and TDS collected per channel. India GST.

tools.name: get_gstr1_summary
tools.description: GSTR-1 outward-supply summary for a period: B2B / B2CL / B2CS section totals and the HSN-wise rollup, for return preparation.

tools.name: get_hsn_summary
tools.description: Per-HSN-code tax rollup (taxable value, CGST/SGST/IGST/cess, invoice count) for a period.

tools.name: get_state_wise_tax
tools.description: Per-state outward-supply and tax breakdown (taxable value, CGST/SGST/IGST, invoice count, intra/inter-state) for a period.

tools.name: get_tax_mismatches
tools.description: Lines where the stored tax doesn't equal rate × taxable value (drift audit), with per-line drift amounts and workflow state. Defaults to open items.

tools.name: get_fba_health
tools.description: Amazon FBA inventory health: aging buckets (0-90 … 365+ days), long-term storage-fee exposure, and recommended actions (e.g. remove/restock).

tools.name: get_marketing_summary
tools.description: Cross-platform ad performance for a window: spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, revenue, ROAS, CTR, CPC, with prior-period deltas and a per-platform breakdown (Google/Meta/Amazon Ads, etc.).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Ad campaigns across connected platforms with per-campaign performance (spend, conversions, ROAS, status) for a window. Requires the campaigns module.

tools.name: get_analytics_summary
tools.description: Google Analytics 4 summary for a window: sessions, users, new users, conversions, engagement, revenue, and source breakdown.

tools.name: get_seo_queries
tools.description: Google Search Console summary for a window: top search queries with impressions, clicks, average position and CTR. Requires the SEO module.

tools.name: get_serp_keywords
tools.description: Tracked SEO keywords with current rankings, search volume, intent and rank trend. Requires the SERP module.

tools.name: list_coach_recommendations
tools.description: AI Coach recommendations inbox: detected issues/opportunities with severity and state (open by default), plus AI-generated action plans.

tools.name: get_ai_wallet
tools.description: AI spend wallet: balance, month-to-date spend, monthly cap, auto-recharge status, and last top-up.

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: In-app notifications inbox: recent alerts with severity, title, and state.

tools.name: get_account_profile
tools.description: The workspace profile: user details and the corporate/tenant profile (legal name, tax IDs, address, reporting currency, completeness).

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.description: Workspace members with their roles and effective permissions. Requires org member-read permission (Owner/Admin).

tools.name: get_brand_pack
tools.description: Brand identity configuration: logo, colors, fonts, voice attributes, banned phrases, required disclaimers.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the workspace's product catalogue by free text (title, brand, or SKU). Returns matching products as citeable results with stable ids — pass an id to `fetch` for full detail. Built for deep-research and retrieval workflows.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full detail of a result returned by `search`, by its id (e.g. "product:<id>"). Returns citeable product records (document text) for deep-research workflows.

tools.name: search_orders
tools.description: Find specific orders across all connected channels. `query` matches an order ID, line-item ID, or SKU (substring). Filter by channel, attribution state, and date range. Money fields are in minor units (paise for INR) — convert to ₹. Use get_order for full detail on one order.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Full detail for a single order by channel + line-item ID, including the linked return (if any) and channel-specific fields. Money is in minor units (paise for INR). Get the channel + lineItemId from search_orders.

tools.name: search_returns
tools.description: Find specific returns across all connected channels. `query` matches a return ID or reverse-shipment tracking (AWB) number (substring). Filter by channel, return bucket, received status, and date range. Each result is a full return record (reason, qty, refund, dates). Money in minor units.

tools.name: search_inventory
tools.description: Find inventory for a specific product across all channels. `query` matches product name, accounting SKU, brand, or variant SKU (substring). Each result is master-grain with per-channel / per-store / per-warehouse stock (available, reserved, in-transit) and a health state (stockout, alert, low, healt

tools.name: search_oms_orders
tools.description: Orders flowing through the zobship fulfillment pipeline, with their state (new → reserved → awaiting_label → labelled → manifested → shipped …), fulfillment type, credit status, and expected ship date. Filter by channel, state, store, warehouse, or exact variant/channel SKU.

tools.name: get_oms_order
tools.description: Full detail for one fulfillment order: line items (SKU, qty, picked/reserved), lifecycle history (state transitions with timestamps), credit consumption, pickup slot, and resolved shipping city/state. Get the id from search_oms_orders.

tools.name: list_picklists
tools.description: Warehouse pick waves (draft → assigned → picking → completed), with line count, expected ship date, and whether a pick PDF exists.

tools.name: get_picklist
tools.description: One picklist: assigned picker, line references, group key, timestamps, and a short-lived pick-PDF link.

tools.name: list_manifests
tools.description: Courier hand-over manifests (draft → submitted → acknowledged), with shipment + order counts and submit/acknowledge timestamps. Filter by warehouse and date range.

tools.name: get_manifest
tools.description: One manifest: shipment + order id lists, state, and a short-lived manifest-PDF link.

tools.name: list_pickers
tools.description: The warehouse-floor picker roster (name, code, phone, assigned warehouse, active status).

tools.name: get_zobship_credits
tools.description: The fulfillment-credit wallet balance (free + paid, in minor units — convert to ₹), paid-credit expiry, and the available recharge tiers. Separate from the AI wallet.

tools.name: get_qradar_overview
tools.description: Quick-commerce shelf-intelligence headline: on-shelf-availability % (OSA), shelves & SKUs tracked, average risk score, potential-sales-loss (PSL, in paise — convert to ₹), pincode coverage, and a daily trendline. Use for 'how is my quick-commerce availability'.

tools.name: list_qradar_skus
tools.description: SKUs in the Q-Radar rotation with current OSA %, risk score, shelf counts, and pricing. Sort by osa_asc to surface the worst-availability SKUs, or filter to those under a target OSA. Own vs competitor SKUs.

tools.name: get_qradar_sku_history
tools.description: Time-series of shelf evaluations for one master product across pincodes and dark-stores in the window — risk score, lever scores, in-stock state, inventory, and price per observation. Get the master id from list_qradar_skus.

tools.name: get_qradar_leak_ledger
tools.description: The CFO-grade potential-sales-loss (PSL) ledger: each out-of-stock window with lost units and lost revenue (paise — convert to ₹), the velocity basis, price/MRP, and an audit hash chain. Ranked by impact.

tools.name: get_qradar_distribution
tools.description: Numeric distribution %: where a quick-commerce platform operates vs where the brand is actually listed, store-type reach (express / instant / longtail), per-state coverage, and a ranked list of gap pincodes with opportunity value (paise). Use for 'where should I expand on Blinkit'.

tools.name: get_qradar_sov
tools.description: Keyword share-of-search on quick-commerce: organic and sponsored presence in the top 5 / 10 / 20 results per tracked keyword and channel. Filter to one keyword or list the highest-organic keywords.

tools.name: list_qradar_alerts
tools.description: Quick-commerce anomaly alerts: out-of-stock spikes, price anomalies, risk escalations, and critical-stock events, with severity and the affected SKU / channel / pincode.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_brand_score, list_coach_recommendations, get_notifications · Private data: get_payments_summary, get_ai_wallet, fetch, search_returns, get_zobship_credits · Public sink: get_shelf_availability, list_manifests, get_qradar_sov · Destructive: get_fba_health.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_brand_score, list_coach_recommendations, get_notifications · Private data: get_payments_summary, get_ai_wallet, fetch, search_returns, get_zobship_credits · Public sink: get_shelf_availability, list_manifests, get_qradar_sov · Destructive: get_fba_health

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
